serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,

reliable and exceptional experience

Working, studying or living abroad? Our international health insurance plans help protect expat
individuals, professionals, students and families as they work and live abroad. Explore our plans
and choose the international expat healthcare cover that’s perfect for you. Only away for less than

# Pardon Our Interruption

As you were browsing something about your browser made us think you were a bot. There are a few
reasons this might happen:
* You've disabled JavaScript in your web browser.
* You're a power user moving through this website with super-human speed.
* You've disabled cookies in your web browser.

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

[ Konsultasi ][7] [ Lihat Layanan ][8]

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

System Integration
Network & Infrastructure
Security Assessment
Managed Security

## Our Services

Layanan System Integrator & Cybersecurity yang siap disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan organisasi Anda.

## Our Partners

Kami berkolaborasi dengan partner teknologi untuk menghadirkan solusi System Integrator &

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

## Investing by J.P. Morgan

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

# Forensic Document Analysis & Document Security for Individuals & Legal Professionals

## "First Look" $250 - Free Consultation 912-622-2777

### Welcome to DocuDNA

We help attorneys prove authenticity, uncover fraud, and secure critical evidence using advanced
forensic science and proprietary document-protection technology - *Doug Cobb, FDE*

##### Let's Talk:

912-432-3832
CEO, FDE

[ Call Now ][17]
[Forensic Document Examinations]

## "WHEN THE EVIDENCE MATTERS, EXPERTISE AND PRECISION MATTERS."

In litigation, documents are often the most powerful—and most vulnerable—form of evidence. DocuDNA
specializes in identifying fraud, manipulation, substitution, and digital alteration with scientific
accuracy. Whether you need a rapid assessment or full expert testimony, we deliver findings you can
rely on in court.

[Paper Forensics Logo]

## [Forensic Document Examinations][18]
* Signature and handwriting authentication
* Alteration, substitution, and fraud detection
* Digital forensics and metadata analysis
* Page numbering and sequence evaluation
* Ink, toner, and substrate analysis
* Expert declarations & trial testimony

[ Explore Forensic Services ][19]

**Documents we examine**
* Forged, altered, or fabricated documents
* Forged Signatures & Questioned Writing
* Identification of “copy and paste” in altered documents
* Substituted Sheets in Documents
* Altered PDF’s & Electronic Documents
* Auto Titles
* Prenuptial Agreements

[ Learn more ][20]

##### Handwriting Analysis (click on arrow for details)

We offer full services for expert handwriting analysis, including forged or questioned signatures.
As a forensic handwriting analysis experts, we offer you technically based reports on authenticity
of the questioned handwriting analysis. In addition to traditional handwriting analysis techniques,
we also offer scientific software analysis which provides the statistical probability of two
signatures being the same or not.

##### Paper Forensics

Our Paper Forensics division provides industry-leading document examination services from
court-qualified expert witnesses. We work closely with individuals, attorneys, and law enforcement
agencies to identify ink and toner anomalies, paper sources, copy and paste signatures or text, and
perform handwriting analysis on any disputed document. You'll receive a concise report of our

# Welcome to DREWSEN Special Papers

### DREWSEN - A reliable and innovative Family-owned business

DREWSEN SPEZIALPAPIERE is a manufacturer of a range of uncoated, wood-free speciality paper. Each
year more than 450 employees produce 170,000 tons of speciality paper using 3 paper machines at the
production and administrative site in Lachendorf, Germany. DREWSEN SPEZIALPAPIERE has been producing
paper since 1538 and as such is one of the longest established paper manufacturers in Germany.

In Great Britain DREWSEN SPEZIALPAPIERE operates under the name of DREWSEN SPECIAL PAPERS Ltd. since
1985.

 

 

## PROSECURA, PROTECH and PROFINO

# DREWSEN Portfolio

### Three product groups for different application areas

For 485 years DREWSEN has been synonymous with development of highly specialised papers. With
innovative capacity, our own R&D department and our interest in the ever-changing demands of papers
today, DREWSEN continually improves its product portfolio.

 

Our Product Groups are:
* **PROSECURA** - Anti-counterfeiting Protection at its best
* **PROTECH** - Technical Paper for Industrial Refining
* **PROFINO** - Paper for a wide Print and Packaging sector

# Modern software.
# Built to perform.

PaperMC improves Minecraft's ecosystem with fast, secure software and an expanding plugin API,
providing quick releases and helpful support as the most widely used, performant, and stable
software available.

[ Downloads ][11][ Documentation ][12]
$

## Your server deserves the best.

[

### Paper

Paper is a Minecraft game server based on Spigot, designed to greatly improve performance and offer
more advanced features and API.

][13][

### Velocity

Velocity is a high-performance, scalable Minecraft proxy server that allows players to connect to
multiple Minecraft servers under the proxy.

][14][

### Folia

Folia is a new fork of Paper that adds regionized multithreading to the server allowing for better
performance and scalability.

][15]

## A diverse plugin ecosystem

Crafted by the PaperMC team & contributors, Hangar is our own dedicated plugin repository, now in
open beta! A place for developers to host their creations, and server owners to enrich their
player's gameplay. From Administration Tools, to Minigames, you'll find it all on Hangar.

[ Check out Hangar ][16]

## Powering players

PaperMC's software powers hundreds of thousands of Minecraft servers on a daily basis, from small
single-servers setups to massive Minecraft server networks. Designed with utility and performance in
mind, it can handle whatever you throw at it.

## The promise of stability

Our software is designed with security and stability in mind. We have consistently been among the
first to fix vulnerabilities in the Minecraft space for years, so you can rest assured that PaperMC
software is a good choice.

# Modern software.
# Built to perform.

PaperMC improves Minecraft's ecosystem with fast, secure software and an expanding plugin API,
providing quick releases and helpful support as the most widely used, performant, and stable
software available.

[ Downloads ][11][ Documentation ][12]
$

## Your server deserves the best.

[

### Paper

Paper is a Minecraft game server based on Spigot, designed to greatly improve performance and offer
more advanced features and API.

][13][

### Velocity

Velocity is a high-performance, scalable Minecraft proxy server that allows players to connect to
multiple Minecraft servers under the proxy.

][14][

### Folia

Folia is a new fork of Paper that adds regionized multithreading to the server allowing for better
performance and scalability.

][15]

## A diverse plugin ecosystem

Crafted by the PaperMC team & contributors, Hangar is our own dedicated plugin repository, now in
open beta! A place for developers to host their creations, and server owners to enrich their
player's gameplay. From Administration Tools, to Minigames, you'll find it all on Hangar.

[ Check out Hangar ][16]

## Powering players

PaperMC's software powers hundreds of thousands of Minecraft servers on a daily basis, from small
single-servers setups to massive Minecraft server networks. Designed with utility and performance in
mind, it can handle whatever you throw at it.

## The promise of stability

Our software is designed with security and stability in mind. We have consistently been among the
first to fix vulnerabilities in the Minecraft space for years, so you can rest assured that PaperMC
software is a good choice.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

# Sanchar Saathi Portal – TAFCOP, Download App & Check SIM Card Details 2026

The **[Sanchar Saathi Portal][18]** is a citizen-friendly initiative by the Department of
Telecommunications (DoT), Government of India, aimed at protecting mobile users from fraud, misuse,
and mobile theft. Through this platform, users can check how many SIM cards are linked to their
Aadhaar, verify the authenticity of their mobile devices, and even block lost or stolen phones. The
integrated system also ensures that telecom services remain transparent and accountable.

In an era of rising digital threats, identity theft, and SIM-related scams, Sanchar Saathi empowers
users to monitor and manage their telecom connections securely.

## **What Is Sanchar Saathi Portal?**

Sanchar Saathi is both a web portal and a mobile app that provides multiple services related to
mobile security and SIM verification. It combines several key modules developed by the DoT to
strengthen consumer safety:
* **CEIR (Central Equipment Identity Register) –** a database that tracks and blocks lost or stolen
  mobile phones.
* **TAFCOP (Telecom Analytics for Fraud Management and Consumer Protection)** – a platform that
  helps users check the number of active SIMs issued in their name.
* **KYM (Know Your Mobile) – **a service that allows users to verify if a mobile device is genuine
  or blacklisted.

The Sanchar Saathi Portal ([www.sancharsaathi.gov.in][27]) allows users to access these features
under a single interface, making it easy to check SIM cards, block stolen phones, and safeguard
personal data.

## **Why Sanchar Saathi Portal is in News**

Recently, the Sanchar Saathi App came into the spotlight when the Department of Telecommunications
issued new directions on 28 November 2025. According to the latest rules, all mobile phone
manufacturers and importers must pre-install the Sanchar Saathi app on every new device sold in
India.

This step aims to make security features accessible to every smartphone user and ensure that
individuals can quickly report lost devices, verify IMEI numbers, and prevent SIM misuse without
needing separate apps or websites.

## **Objectives of Sanchar Saathi Portal**

The main objectives of the Sanchar Saathi Portal are:
* To protect citizens from fake, duplicate, or tampered mobile devices
* To prevent SIM frauds and identity misuse
* To help users report lost or stolen phones easily
* To support cyber safety and block suspicious activity
* To improve transparency in the telecom sector by letting users monitor their own connections

By integrating TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi and CEIR services, the portal strengthens both consumer
awareness and network-level protection.

## **Understanding TAFCOP – Sanchar Saathi Know Your Mobile Connection**

TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi is an essential component of the Sanchar Saathi system. It enables users to
find out how many SIM cards are linked to their identity using their Aadhaar or mobile number.

Here’s how you can use the TAFCOP portal for Aadhaar card mobile number check:
1. Visit the official [**TAFCOP Portal**][28]
2. Enter your mobile number and click on Generate OTP
3. Verify the OTP received on your registered phone
4. The system will display all active SIM cards associated with your Aadhaar number
5. If you find an unknown connection, you can report or block it directly from the portal

This process, also known as Sanchar Saathi SIM Check, ensures that your telecom identity is not
misused for unauthorized activities.

## **Central Equipment Identity Register (CEIR) – Role and Functions**

The CEIR system plays a crucial role in maintaining the national IMEI database. Every mobile phone
has a unique IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) number. The CEIR helps ensure that only
genuine devices operate on Indian telecom networks.

**Functions of CEIR include:**
* Blocking lost or stolen phones across all Indian networks
* Preventing the use of fake or cloned IMEI numbers
* Assisting police and security agencies in tracing stolen devices
* Allowing users to unblock recovered devices

Through CEIR, users can visit the Sanchar Saathi Portal, enter their IMEI number, and block a stolen
phone instantly. This helps reduce mobile theft and the illegal sale of blacklisted devices.

phone instantly. This helps reduce mobile theft and the illegal sale of blacklisted devices.

## **Sanchar Saathi App – Download and Features**

The Sanchar Saathi App, available on the Google Play Store, provides all major features of the
portal in one mobile application.

### **How to Download the Sanchar Saathi App**
1. Open the Play Store on your Android phone
2. Search for “[**Sanchar Saathi App**][29]”
3. Tap Install and open the app after downloading
4. Register using your mobile number and verify via OTP

The app offers a simple dashboard that lets users access CEIR, TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi, and KYM
features in one place. It is expected to come pre-installed on all new smartphones as per DoT’s 2025
guidelines.

**Note**: The Government of India has made it mandatory for all new smartphones to come with the
[**Sanchar Saathi app**][30] pre-installed, ensuring users stay protected from SIM misuse and mobile
fraud.

### **Key Features of the Sanchar Saathi App**
* Check all mobile numbers linked to your identity
* Verify if a mobile device is genuine using its IMEI number
* Block or unblock lost and recovered phones
* Report fraud calls, scam messages, or fake customer-care numbers
* View official and trusted helpline numbers of banks and telecom operators

The app also integrates with a new DoT service called Chakshu, which allows users to report
suspicious communication such as phishing messages or fake financial service calls.

## **TAFCOP Consumer Portal – Benefits for Users**

The TAFCOP Consumer Portal helps users monitor and secure their telecom accounts. Some key benefits
include:
* Easy access to all active SIMs under your name
* Option to report and block unknown or inactive numbers
* SMS alerts when a new SIM is issued under your identity
* A complaint tracking system to follow up on fraud reports

The TAFCOP mobile number check feature ensures no one misuses your identity to obtain extra SIM
cards without consent.

[Zjistěte více][21]

## Kdo ?

SPM je hlavním a nejstarším papírenským výrobcem ceninových a speciálních druhů papírů a kartonů v
České a Slovenské republice. Společnost byla založena v roce 1997 českými akcionáři a navazuje na
více než padesátiletou tradici výroby ceninových papírů.

[Čtěte více ...][22]

## Co ?

Ceninové papíry obsahují různé způsoby jištění proti padělání. Slouží k ochraně dokumentů a jejich
zajištění proti padělání. V současnosti je v naší společnosti vyráběno více než 1 000 různých druhů
ceninových papírů s odlišnou technickou specifikací.

[Čtěte více ...][23]

## Jak ?

SPM disponuje jedinečným know-how, moderní papírenskou technologií, vlastním vývojem a výzkumem,
spolu se zajištěním výroby kontrolními a bezpečnostními systémy. Významnou hodnotou společnosti je
vysoká odbornost a tvůrčí schopnost našich zaměstnanců.

[Čtěte více ...][24]

## Vysoká a garantovaná kvalita.

Vysoká a garantovaná kvalita naší produkce je oceňovaná nejen na domácím trhu, ale především na
nejvyspělejších trzích států Evropské unie, kam je exportována převážná část naší výroby. Trvale
usilujeme o neustálé zvyšování nejen dosahované kvality naší produkce, ale zejména i o zvyšování
úrovně poskytovaných služeb zákazníkovi. Podíl exportu dosahuje 90 % celkové produkce a zboží je
exportováno do více než 70 zemí světa. Veškeré zboží vyrobené ve společnosti SPM splňuje
nejpřísnější normy EU. Svou vysokou odbornost deklarujeme uznávanými certifikáty jakosti.

[Čtěte více ...][25]

### [Ceninové papíry][26]

Papíry jištěné proti padělání. Jako ochrana proti padělání se aplikují různé ochranné prvky přímo do
struktury papíru při jeho výrobě, např. vodoznak, hologramy a jiné.

### [Grafický karton][27]

Kreativní grafické kartony jsou určeny pro kresbu tuhou, perem, akvarelovými barvami, pro
hlubokotisk či měditisk. Dále jsou často využívány pro firemní prezentace, přání, tisk vizitek a
jiné.

# Výroba ceninových papírů a kartonů.

# Aplikace hol. pásky, výroba registračních značek pro ČR, SK.

[Zjistěte více][21]

## Kdo ?

SPM je hlavním a nejstarším papírenským výrobcem ceninových a speciálních druhů papírů a kartonů v
České a Slovenské republice. Společnost byla založena v roce 1997 českými akcionáři a navazuje na
více než padesátiletou tradici výroby ceninových papírů.

[Čtěte více ...][22]

## Co ?

Ceninové papíry obsahují různé způsoby jištění proti padělání. Slouží k ochraně dokumentů a jejich
zajištění proti padělání. V současnosti je v naší společnosti vyráběno více než 1 000 různých druhů
ceninových papírů s odlišnou technickou specifikací.

[Čtěte více ...][23]

## Jak ?

SPM disponuje jedinečným know-how, moderní papírenskou technologií, vlastním vývojem a výzkumem,
spolu se zajištěním výroby kontrolními a bezpečnostními systémy. Významnou hodnotou společnosti je
vysoká odbornost a tvůrčí schopnost našich zaměstnanců.

[Čtěte více ...][24]

## Vysoká a garantovaná kvalita.

Vysoká a garantovaná kvalita naší produkce je oceňovaná nejen na domácím trhu, ale především na
nejvyspělejších trzích států Evropské unie, kam je exportována převážná část naší výroby. Trvale
usilujeme o neustálé zvyšování nejen dosahované kvality naší produkce, ale zejména i o zvyšování
úrovně poskytovaných služeb zákazníkovi. Podíl exportu dosahuje 90 % celkové produkce a zboží je
exportováno do více než 70 zemí světa. Veškeré zboží vyrobené ve společnosti SPM splňuje
nejpřísnější normy EU. Svou vysokou odbornost deklarujeme uznávanými certifikáty jakosti.

[Čtěte více ...][25]

### [Ceninové papíry][26]

Papíry jištěné proti padělání. Jako ochrana proti padělání se aplikují různé ochranné prvky přímo do
struktury papíru při jeho výrobě, např. vodoznak, hologramy a jiné.

### [Grafický karton][27]

Kreativní grafické kartony jsou určeny pro kresbu tuhou, perem, akvarelovými barvami, pro
hlubokotisk či měditisk. Dále jsou často využívány pro firemní prezentace, přání, tisk vizitek a
jiné.

We are the world’s leading supplier of security fibres and components for use in security paper
including cylinder mould  or mould made paper for banknotes, passports, tax stamps and other

security features that are integrated directly into the security paper substrate.

# Elliot A. Boxerbaum Design Award

[Elliot A. Boxerbaum Design Award Image]
Nominations for the 2026 Elliot A. Boxerbaum Award for Security Design Project of the Year are now
open. The award will recognize projects that went live between July 1, 2025 and June 30, 2026. The
Elliot A. Boxerbaum Memorial Award will be presented to a consulting or engineering company which
designed and specified a qualified and completed security design project. It will recognize
collaboration, design excellence, uniqueness, creativity, and administration factors which
contributed to a highly successful security project.

The presentation will occur at the next CONSULT Technical Security Symposium

All valid applicants will have registration fees waived for the next CONSULT. Award project
finalists and designers will be featured in Security magazine.

We congratulate Bala Consulting Engineers and Matt Ezold for their winning submission for the 2025
Elliot A. Boxerbaum Award on 900 & 801 Church in Nashville, TN.

# Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award

[Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award Image]
The Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award recognizes innovation emanating from the security
consulting community. That innovation may be a process, service offering, or unique application of
technology or product. This about introducing novel ideas, methods, or devices, and may be
incremental improvement or radical breakthrough. Ultimately, innovation drives progress and change
by addressing needs, solving problems, and creating new opportunities. Security-specific design
companies, low-voltage system design companies, Architectural and Engineering, and MEP firms all
qualify. Companies are invited to apply for this year's award, with innovations introduced July 1,
2025, through June 30, 2026.

We congratulate ADRM for winning the inaugural 2025 Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award for the
DEFENDER Security Management Platform.

[Learn More and Apply][38]

# Product of the Day - 7/27/2026

[ANPR LUMO - License Plate Reader (Wiegand Output and/or Stand-Alone Access) Logo]

### ANPR LUMO - License Plate Reader (Wiegand Output and/or Stand-Alone Access)
###  
### Nedap Identification Systems
### 

The ANPR Lumo is an all-in-one license plate camera, including embedded software, analyzer, Wiegand
Output and IR illuminator. With a range from 6.5 to 33 feet and reads up to 80 mph, the advanced
camera ensures smooth recognition of vehicles while collecting images of all entry or exit events.
An outstanding add on as a new visitor management system or added visuals to your property's access.
[ **Find Out More >>**][39]

# Product of the Day - 7/27/2026

[Circlelock Combi High Security Half Portal Logo]

### Circlelock Combi High Security Half Portal
###  
### Boon Edam Inc.
### 

Boon Edam designed the Circlelock Combi as a convenient retrofit option to address the risk that
exists with any type of swinging door - once a swinging door is opened by an authorized user, any
number of people may also gain access to a secure area, which is known as "tailgating" or
"piggybacking."

Many facilities use fire-rated swing doors to protect data and assets from destruction by fire, but
this type of door cannot prevent tailgating or piggybacking. The Circlelock Combi attaches to an
existing fire-rated door, converting it immediately into a mantrap solution that prevents
piggybacking 24/7 and eliminates the need for manned supervision, all while maintaining the
fire-rated benefits of the swing door. The Combi also saves considerable space compared to
traditionally built mantrap vestibules that use standard walls and two swinging doors.
[ **Find Out More >>**][40]

# Elliot A. Boxerbaum Design Award

[Elliot A. Boxerbaum Design Award Image]
Nominations for the 2026 Elliot A. Boxerbaum Award for Security Design Project of the Year are now
open. The award will recognize projects that went live between July 1, 2025 and June 30, 2026. The
Elliot A. Boxerbaum Memorial Award will be presented to a consulting or engineering company which
designed and specified a qualified and completed security design project. It will recognize
collaboration, design excellence, uniqueness, creativity, and administration factors which
contributed to a highly successful security project.

The presentation will occur at the next CONSULT Technical Security Symposium

All valid applicants will have registration fees waived for the next CONSULT. Award project
finalists and designers will be featured in Security magazine.

We congratulate Bala Consulting Engineers and Matt Ezold for their winning submission for the 2025
Elliot A. Boxerbaum Award on 900 & 801 Church in Nashville, TN.

# Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award

[Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award Image]
The Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award recognizes innovation emanating from the security
consulting community. That innovation may be a process, service offering, or unique application of
technology or product. This about introducing novel ideas, methods, or devices, and may be
incremental improvement or radical breakthrough. Ultimately, innovation drives progress and change
by addressing needs, solving problems, and creating new opportunities. Security-specific design
companies, low-voltage system design companies, Architectural and Engineering, and MEP firms all
qualify. Companies are invited to apply for this year's award, with innovations introduced July 1,
2025, through June 30, 2026.

We congratulate ADRM for winning the inaugural 2025 Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award for the
DEFENDER Security Management Platform.

# Product of the Day - 7/27/2026

[Circlelock Combi High Security Half Portal Logo]

### Circlelock Combi High Security Half Portal
###  
### Boon Edam Inc.
### 

Boon Edam designed the Circlelock Combi as a convenient retrofit option to address the risk that
exists with any type of swinging door - once a swinging door is opened by an authorized user, any
number of people may also gain access to a secure area, which is known as "tailgating" or
"piggybacking."

Many facilities use fire-rated swing doors to protect data and assets from destruction by fire, but
this type of door cannot prevent tailgating or piggybacking. The Circlelock Combi attaches to an
existing fire-rated door, converting it immediately into a mantrap solution that prevents
piggybacking 24/7 and eliminates the need for manned supervision, all while maintaining the
fire-rated benefits of the swing door. The Combi also saves considerable space compared to
traditionally built mantrap vestibules that use standard walls and two swinging doors.
[ **Find Out More >>**][40]

## Our Heritage

## SPMCIL though a new entity is composed of units that have a rich & long history of handling the
## security printing & minting in the nation.

## 18th Century- Minting of coins started at Calcutta Mint. In 1790 modern machinery was brought
## from England and second Mint was established. Bronze, Silver and Gold coins were getting Minted
## from these mints.

## 1918- British sovereign were minted during 1918 as the Mint in Mumbai was declared as branch of
## Royal Mint of London.

Sustana is an industry-leading producer of quality fiber-based products and services built on a
solid commitment to sustainability and continuous improvement. 

From recovery to fiber to paper production, we produce the clean materials used in coffee cups, food
packaging, your favorite book, and so much more.

Let’s get started.

under a united Sustana brand.

As one, we are stronger and amplify our solid commitment to sustainability and continuous
improvement.

Join us on our journey to create real change from within.

#### grade and luxury packaging

100% inclusion without the need of a barrier or coating.

The impact of EnviroLife on climate change is 26 percent lower than the average virgin fiber. It
also requires 9 times less water to produce than virgin fiber.

## Papetiers depuis 400 ans

### Qualité à la française

Au cœur des Alpes, Les Papeteries de Vizille, imprégnées d’un savoir-faire séculaire fabriquent des
produits vendus en France et dans le monde entier.
De taille humaine, agiles et certifiées **ISO 22000 - ISO 9001 et ISO 50001**, Les Papeteries de
Vizille possèdent 2 activités, sur un même site :

- La fabrication de** papiers de spécialité **

- La production de **sacs industriels en papier de moyenne et grande contenance **

Les Papeteries de Vizille s’engagent auprès des générations futures à la transmission des savoirs
tout en assurant un avenir durable, pour une industrie plus verte. 

[Mieux nous connaitre][50]
[bâtiments historique dans le parc des papeteries de Vizille]

## Engagés au quotidien

### Amélioration continue

Les Papeteries de Vizille travaillent à l'amélioration de leurs consommations quotidiennes et de
leur impact environnemental afin de proposer une industrie plus respectueuse de son écosystème :
pâtes certifiées** PEFC ou FSC**, amélioration du **mix énergétique** (turbines hydroélectriques,
chaufferie biomasse), **traitement **physico-chimique et biologique **des eaux**, amélioration des
process pour diminuer la consommation d'eau et d'électricité...

Ce sont autant d'actions et de projets qui nous permettent d'intégrer notre politique
environnementale à notre stratégie d'entreprise.

## Papetiers depuis 400 ans

### Qualité à la française

Au cœur des Alpes, Les Papeteries de Vizille, imprégnées d’un savoir-faire séculaire fabriquent des
produits vendus en France et dans le monde entier.
De taille humaine, agiles et certifiées **ISO 22000 - ISO 9001 et ISO 50001**, Les Papeteries de
Vizille possèdent 2 activités, sur un même site :

- La fabrication de** papiers de spécialité **

- La production de **sacs industriels en papier de moyenne et grande contenance **

Les Papeteries de Vizille s’engagent auprès des générations futures à la transmission des savoirs
tout en assurant un avenir durable, pour une industrie plus verte. 

[Mieux nous connaitre][50]
[bâtiments historique dans le parc des papeteries de Vizille]

## Engagés au quotidien

### Amélioration continue

Les Papeteries de Vizille travaillent à l'amélioration de leurs consommations quotidiennes et de
leur impact environnemental afin de proposer une industrie plus respectueuse de son écosystème :
pâtes certifiées** PEFC ou FSC**, amélioration du **mix énergétique** (turbines hydroélectriques,
chaufferie biomasse), **traitement **physico-chimique et biologique **des eaux**, amélioration des
process pour diminuer la consommation d'eau et d'électricité...

Ce sont autant d'actions et de projets qui nous permettent d'intégrer notre politique
environnementale à notre stratégie d'entreprise. 

[Engagés pour l'environnement][51]
